purpose: Document why Alaska was outside the prespecified main geography and quantify an inclusion sensitivity.
original_geographic_target: Contiguous United States and District of Columbia.
exclusion_stage: Whole-jurisdiction geographic target, before focal-window outcome extraction.
interpretation: The main three-center window was technically assignable for observed Alaska event appearances. Alaska was excluded because the prespecified target and solar-validation domain were contiguous-US, not because Alaska does not observe DST or because the main-window solar event was generally undefined.
alaska_only_full_adjusted_models: Unsupported because the narrow-window Alaska tables were too sparse for the full high-dimensional model.
